swing_trade_setup.best_structure: Buy SPY ATM 3-week calls on pullbacks to the 50MA ($759 area); lean into long gamma given short-vol positioning makes rallies grind and drops snap.

swing_trade_setup.avoid: Selling naked premium into this compressed-vol environment — the risk/reward is poor and gap risk is real with positioning this one-sided.

The Treasury yield curve is steepening from inversion, which is historically a constructive signal for equities if growth holds.

swing_trade_setup.avoid: Buying OTM calls at current levels with TSLA already 9% above the 50MA and volume declining 69% — the pullback risk/reward is unfavorable. Also avoid RIVN and any illiquid small-cap EV names.
